name: Link Nacional Crowdfunding Extension
author: linknacional

sections.description:
This is an extension of the WP Crowdfunding plugin that allows you to create customizable WPCrowdfunding components through the Elementor plugin. It enables users to style the components according to their preferences. Currently, it includes the following components:

Campaign Listing: Lists all campaigns using an Elementor component.

Product Name: Displays the name of the product associated with the campaign.

Author Name: Shows the campaign author’s name, with an option to customize a prefix.

Raised Percentage: Displays the percentage of the fundraising goal achieved.

Fundraising Goal: Shows the total fundraising goal amount of the campaign.

Funds Raised: Displays the total amount of funds raised.

Days Remaining: Calculates and shows the number of days remaining for the campaign.

Ending Method: Indicates the method by which the campaign will end.

Location: Shows the location linked to the campaign.

Donation Form: Adds a form for users to make donations directly.

Product Image: Displays the main image of the campaign’s product.

Product Image Gallery: Shows a gallery with images associated with the product.

Product Summary: Presents a short description or summary of the product.

Author Biography: Displays the biography of the campaign’s author.

Favorite Campaign: Allows highlighting a campaign as a favorite.

Campaign Tabs: Displays tabs with detailed information about the campaign.

Average Rating: Shows the average rating from supporters.

Select for Campaign Listing Template: Adds a template selector to customize the campaign listing.

Custom Template for WPCrowdfunding Product: Enables customizing the product layout directly.

Short Description

An extension of the WP Crowdfunding plugin that allows you to create customizable components through the Elementor plugin, enabling users to style components according to their preferences.

External Libraries

  • ElevateZoom: This is an external jQuery library that enables a zoom effect on images when hovered over, providing an elegant and interactive experience for product images.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. In the WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on “Upload Plugin” and select the ZIP file of the plugin you downloaded.
  4. Click on “Install Now” and then “Activate Plugin”.
  5. Make sure the WP Crowdfunding plugin is also activated.
sections.faq:
What is the license of the plugin?

This plugin is released under a GPLv2 license.

What do I need to use this plugin?

You need to have the WP Crowdfunding plugin installed.

Is it necessary to make settings? Which are they?

No, however, in the WP Crowdfunding settings, it is possible to make specific settings for the plugins.

There is a configuration menu where you can use the shortcode [lkn_wpcf_simple_registration]. This shortcode can be used anywhere on the site pages. In this menu, you can style and configure the behavior of this shortcode, including:
* User name hiding during registration
* Email validation
* Activation of nonce verification during registration
* URL redirection after registration
* Select to choose a custom template that replaces the default product template of WP Crowdfunding.
* Default URL redirection after email submission
* Default URL redirection after email submission failure
